notes: A clean three-rung courier quest. The one trap on the page is its own sub-bullet: Titus synthesizes the [KI] Bottle of military ink but it is NEVER given to you -- it exists only inside the cutscene -- so it is deliberately not evidence anywhere, even though it resolves (ki 1765). The thing you actually carry is the [KI] Military ink package, which is step 2's evidence because that is where it is granted, and step 3's requirement because that is what you deliver. Bullet 5 ('you will complete the quest') is the outcome, not a step. The two Conflux numbers are travel advice and stay in the notes. Fame 'aalt' is an Abyssea zone code, not one of the nine regions, so it gates nothing and only the raw survives.

notes: The unnumbered line above bullet 1 is an explanation of why the quest exists, not a step. Bullet 2 is what talking to Chululu GIVES you -- five of one randomly chosen card -- so it is folded into step 1 rather than made a step of its own. It is tempting to make 'five of any one card' step 1's evidence as a four-way alt, but every one of those four names reappears in step 2's AND-list and the duplicate-evidence gate is on the resolved id, not the count: that would demote the whole quest. So step 1 rests on quest acceptance, and the only evidence in the ladder sits where it is genuinely diagnostic -- holding one of each of the four cards, which is exactly the state bullet 3 tells you to reach. Step 2 is unmarkable by nature: the cards come from other players and bazaars, not from any entity in the world. Bullet 5 is a real-life-day cooldown on re-obtaining cards, not a step. The page names only four cards, so only four are recorded even though the parent quest uses more.

notes: Three bullets, three steps, no traps in the ladder -- but two things about the page are worth recording. First, the header's 'Quest Reqs: Bottle of fertilizer X' is not a prerequisite at all: it is the thing you fetch DURING the quest, so it gates nothing and lives on step 2 instead. It resolves as a KEY ITEM (2263), not an item, which is why kind is 'ki' on both steps. Second, the page never says which zone Shipilolo is in -- only 'in front of the Inventors' Coalition' -- and the one zone the sub-bullets mention, Western Adoulin, is about the Rala Waterways entrance and nothing to do with him. Rather than guess a coalition's city half, step 2 carries a null zone; the resolver reports the name as unambiguous, so a nil zone costs nothing here. Fame 'Adoulin' is not one of the nine regions and gates nothing.

The header has NO Start field at all, so start is recovered from the walkthrough: the first and only thing bullet 1 tells you to interact with is the Provenance Protocrystal, in Provenance. It folds to a markable key, so the quest gets a marker it would otherwise never have had. Bullet 1 is genuinely two actions -- examine the crystal to open the fight, then win the fight -- and is split accordingly. The real loss is the requirement: 'the three key item petrifacts' are never NAMED anywhere on this page, only counted, so no item list can be written for them; items_partial is set on step 1 to say the requirement list is knowingly short, and nothing is invented. They are consumed on entry and the fight can be re-entered by reobtaining them, but the quest itself completes once, so Repeatable stays false. Bullet 2's Regal Pawprints is given no location; victory happens in Provenance and the pawprints are checked 'upon victory', so Provenance is carried across -- that inference is the reason this quest is medium rather than high. Fame 'Wings of the Goddess' is an expansion, not one of the nine regions.

notes: A three-rung fetch quest. Bullet 2 IS an instruction ('Obtain a Copper Ingot'), unlike the request-restatements elsewhere in this batch, so it earns an obtain step -- and holding the ingot is genuinely observable, which turns it into the one evidence point in the quest. Its whole sub-tree is shopping advice: four ore vendors in two cities and a synthesis recipe. Bullet 4 is the repeat rule, not an action, and it hides a real gate the schema cannot express: the quest is Repeatable, but only until you reach Bastok fame level 2, after which it is not.
